metaDescription: GitHub hosts Git repositories with pull requests, code review, issues, GitHub Actions CI/CD, Codespaces and Copilot. See its features, Free, Team and Enterprise pricing, strengths, limitations and alternatives.
overview: GitHub is a platform for hosting Git repositories and building software together. Teams use pull requests, code review, issues and projects to plan and ship work, and GitHub Actions runs CI/CD workflows directly from your repositories.

GitHub also includes Codespaces cloud development environments, Dependabot security alerts, GitHub Packages and GitHub Pages, and integrates with GitHub Copilot for AI coding. The free plan includes unlimited public and private repositories; Team and Enterprise add collaboration, security and governance features.

features.title: Repositories
features.text: Unlimited public and private Git repositories on every plan.

features.title: Pull requests and code review
features.text: Review code with comments, required reviewers and code owners on Team.

features.title: GitHub Actions
features.text: Automate builds, tests and deployments with CI/CD workflows.

features.title: Codespaces
features.text: Cloud development environments, with monthly core hours included on Free.

features.title: Security
features.text: Dependabot alerts and security features, with more on higher plans.

features.title: Copilot integration
features.text: AI coding with GitHub Copilot; Enterprise now includes Copilot access.

useCases: Project planning with issues and projects
strengths: Unlimited public and private repositories for free.
The largest developer community, with deep tool integrations.
CI/CD, Codespaces and packages built in.
Team plan is affordable at $4 per user a month.
limitations: Protected branches, code owners and required reviewers on private repos need Team.
SAML SSO and IP allow lists need Enterprise.
Actions, Codespaces and storage beyond included amounts are billed by usage.
Enterprise costs $21 per user a month.
Copilot's paid AI features are billed separately from Free and Team.

pricing.summary: Free plan available. Team and Enterprise are billed per user. Usage of Actions, Codespaces, Packages and Git LFS beyond included amounts is billed separately.
